# Local UI assets

- NES.css 2.3.0: https://unpkg.com/nes.css@2.3.0/css/nes.min.css (MIT; see `nes.css/LICENSE.txt`, from the upstream v2.3.0 tag).
- Press Start 2P: https://fonts.bunny.net/css?family=press-start-2p:400 (downloaded 2026-09-30). All five WOFF2 subsets are included, with local URLs and `font-display: swap`. SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `press-start-2p/OFL.txt`, from the Google Fonts `ofl/pressstart2p` source.

Keep licenses with the files. To update, replace the assets deliberately and verify the pixel UI and font subsets. These files are excluded from automatic formatting to preserve upstream CSS and license text.
